content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Presets stripe

Stripe is a payment processing giant, but its reach is limited, and it's not available in many countries. PayPal offers a broader range of services, but its fees can be steep, and account suspensions can be crippling. Gumroad is a popular platform for digital creators, but it's not a payment processor; it's a sales funnel. These options might seem like the only choices, but they come with significant risks and limitations. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a base-layer alternative that gives you control over your digital store, automates payment processing, and ensures you own your data. This infrastructure is not a workaround; it's a permanent structural solution built on free and open-source tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-supabase-order-database-digital-stores-complete-infrastructure-2|COREMERCH guide to supabase]], and NOWPayments. With sovereign commerce infrastructure, you can deploy your digital store in 48 hours, load up to 5 products, and configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for email deliverability. You'll also get end-to-end testing and 30-day support. This is not a solution for the faint of heart; it's a robust infrastructure designed for digital creators who want to take control of their business.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Traditional payment platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad often exclude certain countries due to regulatory issues, high fees, or other concerns. This leaves digital creators in those countries with limited options. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed for digital creators in restricted countries. With tools like NOWPayments, you can process payments in 300+ cryptocurrencies, with fees as low as $0.10 per transaction. This means you can reach customers in countries where traditional payment platforms are unavailable. Additionally, sovereign commerce infrastructure is built on free and open-source tools, which means you can deploy and manage your digital store without relying on a single vendor or platform. This gives you the flexibility to adapt to changing regulations and market conditions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Traditional payment platforms often come with high fees, slow payment processing, and unclear costs. For example, PayPal's fees can range from 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction to 5% + $0.30 per transaction, depending on the country and payment method. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure charges a flat fee of 0.5% for payment processing, with no hidden costs or slow payment processing. With NOWPayments, you can also set up automatic payment verification, which ensures that payments are processed quickly and securely. This means you can get paid faster and with less hassle, without sacrificing control over your digital store.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure is not a workaround; it's a permanent structural solution built on free and open-source tools.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Traditional payment platforms often require you to rely on their infrastructure and tools, which can limit your control over your digital store. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full ownership and control over your digital store, including payment processing, product delivery, and data storage. With tools like Supabase and Cloudflare Workers, you can automate payment processing, product delivery, and other tasks, ensuring that your digital store runs smoothly and efficiently. This means you can focus on creating and selling digital products, without worrying about the underlying infrastructure.
